design: Nested rolling origin; 5v5 own attack xG and own xG-against windows changed separately and together; other inputs remain 60-game; tuning on S-1, score S; paired bootstrap stratified by season, 10000 draws.
headline: No tested faster/slower 5v5 xG window improved team-goal MAE over the 60-game reference. Short windows reduced average bias but worsened or did not improve game-level MAE. 100-game windows were worse.
source_snapshot: 2026-11-04 rebuilt data; frozen source hashes differ.
